currentParagraphText: “I would be remiss to miss being there,” the Viper relented. “I guess the real bidders will be the A-grades today, right?”

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I would be remiss to miss being there,” the Viper relented. “I guess the real bidders will be the A-grades today, right?”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: For the first time, Jake had confirmed that there were A-grades present, which only made Jake wonder how strong the Viper was even more than before. Jake did find it a bit off that he hadn’t been able to feel the Viper’s grade despite the minor displays of magic, but he wasn’t going to question it too much as he just enjoyed being along for the ride while looking forward to when the real juicy stuff began.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “No one told you to buy anything, but giving an extra number out shouldn’t be a problem, and besides, having more people there makes for more competitive betting even if you don’t bet yourself,” the man said, inviting the Viper into the auction hall itself.
